decisions: Preserve the user-selected Velorah video landing page and serif typography, branded as Butaq.

Place the supplied purple-blue OGL voice orb on a dedicated /voice/ page linked as Voice in the navbar. Animate only on microphone speech, freeze in silence, respect reduced motion, and share the call microphone.
Connect voice and text input to the existing router API and show actual server traces beneath the call.

Automatically bootstrap the bundled synthetic catalogue into an empty database. Keep the Voice page free of upload forms and admin credentials; omit the demo banner and sample utterance from Voice as requested.

Use the shared Velorah navbar with Voice and Admin links across the site. Match admin to the hero with Instrument Serif headings, monochrome tokens, a compact sign-in form, and pill buttons; preserve all admin actions.

Use only Asme featured-video animation as the full-height admin sign-in background behind a transparent overlaid navbar, with a readable glass form, a still poster for reduced motion or video errors, and a pause control.

Use only the Mindloop hero animation behind the existing Voice page and transparent navbar, with no imported template copy or forms. Share background playback controls and reduced-motion behavior with admin.

Use concise English copy on the homepage: explain the insurance voice assistant, give concrete steps using current Voice controls, describe the trace and admin tools, and distinguish demo limits from working features.

Add Telephony to the shared navbar. Use only Asme philosophy flower animation behind the Telephony page, matching the shared serif headings and transparent navbar. Show the user-provided number +1 (201) 231-1497 with a native tel link and Call Butaq action. Use Talk to Butaq consistently for homepage Voice links.
